command.OPEN.meaning.value: Create the basic record. No decision or payment is inferred.

command.AMEND_REGISTRATION.meaning.value: Replace the initial facts. The handler's case reference remains unchanged.

command.CORRECT_CASE.meaning.value: Correct existing decided, paid, or closed case facts atomically. Keep reads accepted values; clearing a payment record does not reverse an external transfer.

command.DECIDE.meaning.value: Record or replace the decided amount and currency. This does not send money.

command.WITHDRAW_DECISION.meaning.value: Remove the unpaid decision tuple while retaining its earlier history.

command.RECORD_PAYMENT.meaning.value: Record the date the full decided amount was actually paid. This does not execute or verify a transfer.

command.CLEAR_PAYMENT.meaning.value: Remove an erroneously recorded payment date. This is not a refund or reversal of an actual transfer. Earlier history remains.

command.CLOSE.meaning.value: Set the case status to CLOSED. Closing does not imply any payment.

command.REOPEN.meaning.value: Set the case status to OPENED, retaining its other fields and history.

field.incidentDate.meaning.value: Date on which the incident occurred.

field.incidentNotificationDate.meaning.value: Date when this claims handler was first notified of the incident by anyone, not necessarily the claimant. Not the date another insurer or organisation was notified.

field.incidentCountry.meaning.value: Country where the incident occurred; recorded as entered without inferring applicable law.

field.claimantName.meaning.value: Name of the claimant, whether a private person or a company. No separate party-type or legal-identity fields.

field.insurerName.meaning.value: Name of the insurer claimed to be responsible. This does not establish ultimate liability or a recourse-chain position.

field.claimedAmount.meaning.value: Amount claimed by the claimant, encoded as exact non-negative decimal text. Zero is a recorded amount, not a substitute for unknown.

field.claimedCurrency.meaning.value: Three-letter uppercase identifier for the claimed amount; no currency conversion or registry inference.

field.caseReference.meaning.value: Reference assigned by the claims handler operating this register, not an insurer reference. Unique, immutable and case-sensitive within one installation.

field.paymentDecisionDate.meaning.value: Date when this claims handler decided the amount to be paid. Null until a decision is recorded; not a payment or bank instruction.

field.payableAmount.meaning.value: Decided amount to be paid, in exact non-negative decimal text. Null until decided; may differ from the claimed amount.

field.payableCurrency.label.value: Currency of amount to be paid

field.payableCurrency.meaning.value: Currency of the decided amount. Null until decided; it need not equal the claimed currency.

field.paymentDate.meaning.value: Date when the decided amount was actually paid, as recorded by the operator. Null while unpaid or unknown. One full payment only; recording does not execute or independently verify a bank transfer.

field.status.meaning.value: Administrative state OPENED or CLOSED, independent of decision and payment. No additional case statuses.

group.registration.meaning.value: Keep the accepted registration facts or replace all seven registration inputs together.

group.decision.meaning.value: Keep the accepted decision, replace its complete date, amount, and currency tuple, or clear it.

group.payment.meaning.value: Keep the accepted payment record, replace its date, or clear the recorded payment date; clearing does not reverse an external transfer.
